from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper in the collection, with its title and citations to other provided papers."""
    paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper in the collection")
    references_from_other_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
